description: End-to-end bootstrap front door for this entire catalog — invoke as `/iru-setup-repository` and use it as THE one entry point new users should reach for to bootstrap any repository, instead of hunting for which of this catalog's stack-specific orchestrators applies. Covers every project type this catalog can scaffold — `java-library`, Spring Boot services (`java-springboot`, `java-springboot-hilla`, `kotlin-springboot`, `kotlin-springboot-hilla`), Quarkus services (`java-quarkus`, `kotlin-quarkus`), `typescript-library`, `react-web`, `nextjs`, `angular-web`, `nestjs`, PHP (`php-laravel`, `php-wordpress-plugin`, `php-wordpress-theme`, `php-prestashop-module`), Python (`python-fastapi`, `python-django`), `android-library`, `android-app`, `swift-library`, `apple-app` (`ios`/`ipados`/`macos`/`watchos`/`visionos`, SwiftUI or UIKit, MVVM or MVC), `react-native-app` (`expo`/`metro` toolchain), `ionic-app` (`angular`/`react`), `kmp-app` (Kotlin Multiplatform for Android + iOS, `compose`/`native` UI), and the desktop apps `macos-app` (native macOS, `swiftui`/`appkit`) and `windows-app` (.NET 10, `wpf`/`winui`/`winforms`), and agent-friendly command-line tools `cli-tool` (`rust`/`go`/`swift`/`dotnet`, optional terminal UI) — by surveying the working directory (running `iru-explore` first when it already holds code) to detect which one applies, asking only the shared, cross-cutting questions the detected/chosen type still needs, then delegating the actual scaffold to the matching stack orchestrator (`iru-setup-java-library-repository`, `iru-setup-java-springboot`, `iru-setup-quarkus-repository`, `iru-setup-typescript-repository`, `iru-setup-php-repository`, `iru-setup-python-repository`, `iru-setup-android-repository`, `iru-setup-swift-repository`, `iru-setup-kmp-repository`, `iru-setup-macos-repository`, `iru-setup-windows-repository`, or `iru-setup-cli-repository`) via `iru-isolated-skill-executor`. Accepts `args` (`key: value` lines) to pre-resolve `project-type`, `open-source`, `visibility` (`public`/`private`/`internal`, otherwise detected via `gh repo view` or asked), `ci` (`yes`/`no`), `ci-tests` (`unit`/`full`), `pages` (`yes`/`no`), `publish`, `distribution`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/`sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`, scripted runs only), `flavor`, the stack-shape keys `language` (JVM `java`/`kotlin`, or a command-line tool's `rust`/`go`/`swift`/`dotnet`), `build-tool`, `layout`, and `frontend` (JVM services), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off` — UI types: how strictly the UI tests' automated accessibility checks gate, recorded in `.ui-quality.yml`), `python-version`, `platforms`, `framework`, `toolchain` (React Native `expo`/`metro`), `native-builds`, `ui` (Kotlin Multiplatform `compose`/`native`, macOS `swiftui`/`appkit`, Windows `wpf`/`winui`/`winforms`, a command-line tool's `none`/`tui`), `architecture` (desktop apps' `mvvm`/`mvc`), `integration-branch`, `stable-branch`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, and `organization-url` — forwarding each only to the delegated orchestrator whose own `args` contract actually accepts it, and never asking a question `args` already answered or one the delegated orchestrator asks itself. Asks whether CI workflows are wanted, whether Sonar receives CI reports, whether CI runs unit-only or the full test suite, and (private repos) whether docs go to GitHub Pages, stating the Actions-minutes / SonarCloud / Pages cost differences between public and private repositories. Announces whether it is setting up from scratch or updating an existing repository (with an inventory of the prior setup it found); on an existing repository it runs `iru-explore` first and forces `mode: existing`, and every delegated component then warns about each pre-existing artifact and asks whether to keep, update, or replace it. Use whenever a user wants to bootstrap (or catch up) a repository and either doesn't know or shouldn't have to know which of this catalog's twelve stack-specific setup orchestrators to invoke directly.
